camera.title: Camera
camera.fallbackTitle: Use your phone camera to take the photo
camera.captured: Photo captured · location and time sealed into it
camera.unreadable: That photo couldn't be read. Try another one.

issue.insecure: The live camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. You can still take a photo with your phone's camera.
issue.unsupported: This browser has no live camera. You can still take or choose a photo.
issue.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or take a photo with your phone's camera.
issue.notfound: No camera was found on this device. Choose a photo instead.
issue.busy: The camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again, or choose a photo.
issue.failed: The camera couldn't start. You can still take or choose a photo.

unit.session: {count, plural, one {{n} care session} other {{n} care sessions}}

log.title: Log an action
log.photoHint: Take a photo of the work. Location and time are sealed into it.
log.captured: Photo captured · location and time sealed into it
log.capturedNoGps: Photo captured · no GPS fix, so it will wait for a teammate
log.noPhotoNote: Without a photo the action waits for a teammate to confirm it.
log.verifyingSub: Checking where and when it was taken, and that it’s a new photo.
log.treesAdded: {count, plural, one {{n} tree added to My trees} other {{n} trees added to My trees}}
log.failed: Couldn’t save the action. Try again.

reason.ok: Verified: the photo matches the action.
reason.unavailable: Some checks couldn’t run. A teammate or moderator can confirm it.
reason.rate_limited: Too many checks today. A teammate can confirm it.
reason.no_photo: No photo was added. A teammate can confirm it.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.provisionalNote: Points count once a reviewer confirms it.
contribution.coolingNone: This action doesn’t add modeled cooling, but it keeps the plan going.
contribution.groundBody: Your photo is now a ground-truth point. It checks what the satellite sees here (new canopy, greenness and surface heat), the way NASA scientists use GLOBE citizen photos.
contribution.groundSrc: Stays on this device in v0 · GLOBE-style protocol
contribution.survivalNote: Each check earns points. Miss one and the points pause; they don’t vanish.
contribution.shareText: I just logged “{action}” with Atmos X: {points} points toward a cooler {zone}.
contribution.notFound: This action isn’t on this device.
contribution.rejectedNote: A reviewer didn’t confirm this. No points were added.
contribution.reviewSub: You’re a teammate or moderator. Confirm only what you know happened.
contribution.waitSub: A teammate or a moderator confirms it. You can’t confirm your own action.

budget.title: Budget
budget.splitSoloSub: A team of 5 brings it down to {each} each.
budget.estimateNote: Prices are AI estimates for this area, checked against reference costs. Confirm with suppliers.

nurseries.title: Nurseries
nurseries.note: Location only: Atmos X doesn’t sell plants. Places come from OpenStreetMap and a short curated list. Directions open your maps app.
nurseries.noneSub: Try the curated list in Dhaka, or search your maps app for “plant nursery”.

location_plausible.title: Plausible place
location_plausible.rule: Not on water or inside a building, no impossible jump

capture_source.title: Taken with the camera
capture_source.rule: In-app camera, or photo time and place match

content_plausible.title: Photo fits the action
content_plausible.rule: Rough check: enough green, or a bright roof

gps_near_tree.title: At the tree
gps_near_tree.rule: Within 100 m of where it was planted
